te: Progress on policy proposals to expand and upgrade dual vocational education (industry and investment)
se: The meeting considered the progress of the working group preparing policy recommendations on expanding and upgrading dual vocational education. The working group and related agencies were invited: the Federation of Thai Industries and the Office of the Board of Investment (BOI), according to the press release the Senate published.
it: Progress of the working group preparing policy recommendations on expanding and upgrading dual vocational education (Federation of Thai Industries and Office of the Board of Investment)

Progress on policy proposals to strengthen competitiveness (PISA)
se: The meeting considered the progress of the working group preparing policy recommendations to strengthen competitiveness (PISA), with the working group and related agencies invited. The meeting noted the results and asked the working group to prepare a study report for the subcommittee, according to the press release the Senate published.
it: Progress of the working group preparing policy recommendations to strengthen competitiveness (PISA)

te: Meeting summary video · Progress on policy proposals to strengthen competitiveness (PISA)
Work approach and plan for fiscal year 2027
se: The meeting considered the subcommittee's approach and work plan for fiscal year 2027. It agreed to set the issues to study, focusing on following up and speeding up matters already under consideration, and on key issues within the subcommittee's duties and powers, such as the draft National Education Act and the management of small schools, according to the press release the Senate published.
it: Approach and work plan for fiscal year 2027: the draft National Education Act and the management of small schools
